bb.name: Usage Meter
bb.description: Two rings around a sidebar footer button track the Claude subscription limits — the outer one the five-hour session, the inner one the week, each colouring by its own value, with the per-model limit as a dot and every window, reset time and plan in the popup. The Usage page behind them says where the limits went: the same summary Claude Code's own VS Code extension gives — long context, subagent-heavy sessions, sessions running in parallel, eight-hour sessions, cache misses, and the skills, subagents, plugins and MCP servers behind them — computed from the local transcripts with the same weighted-cost formula and the same thresholds, over the last 24 hours or the last 7 days. Beside it, the figures the extension has no counterpart for: workflow runs and background /go runs with their agents, duration and status, skills with how often they ran and how heavy their instructions are, and tokens by project, model and bb thread.
